target: NexusMutual RWI Vault USDC yield route: become a registry member (lock NXM through the NexusMutual core), deposit USDC into vault 0xcAFeAA466736ac01e0AC9Ca72644beF348694731 and earn the ~10.6% base APY
why: Thin but real: 400 USD principal earns ~0.12 USD/day in USDC (getBaseApy 0.1059 measured at head 26377427); loss bounded to gas (deposits/redeems are ERC20 transfers); no latency race (yield accrues by time). Gates: registry membership is onlyMembershipOperator (NXM lock through the core), redeem is async (operator-only fulfillRedeems batch), assetCap 10M USDC below the 30.57M totalAssets means deposits queue until the core fulfills them.
next_steps: Gate CLOSED negative for a self-service pilot (attempt 728): membership = registry addMember callable only by the membership operator, which on mainnet is NexusMutual's own relay 0x09f0fb4405e4445849519511a407e68f697d1822 (A_MEMBERSHIP_OPERATOR slot; same contract also holds A_VAULT_OPERATOR and fulfilled the redeem); both measured member adds were signed-forward calls from team EOA 0x9063a2c78afd6c8a3510273d646111df67d6cb4b (tx 0xc09dfb22 26340209, tx 0x9ad90a2a 26354294). No NXM lock is required from a joining member (V2M NXMaster 0x01BFd82675DBCc7762C84019cA518e701C0cD07e has no becomeMember). Entry is permissioned: needs_human: the NexusMutual team must addMember(bot address) through their relay - one free tx; alternatively an incumbent member can transfer membership to us with changeMemberAddress(bot). Deposit self-fulfills in the request tx (totalAssets 2,050,054.78 USDC < assetCap 10M at head 26385965); redeem stays queued until the operator relay runs fulfillRedeems - measured lag 19412 blocks ~ 2.7 days (exit latency is team-owned). EV thinner than the lead assumed: getBaseApy() raw 1.0600e18 = 6.00 pct APY at head (cross-checked against the member's share-price growth 1.038273 -> 1.038717 over 2.7 d ~ 5.9-6.0 pct annualized) -> 400 USD = 0.066 USD/day, not 0.12. Rank vs the other deposit pilots (leads 112/113/114): only build if the team addMember comes with the Axcess approveLender ask; no keeper reward, no NXM capital, exit gas trivial (ERC20 transfers), worst-case loss = gas only (L fine).

why: Measured 2026-11-09 run 3cdbd86e (attempt 727; wiki mechanisms/axcess-loanvault.md): deposit route live and 400 USD fits (min deposit 1.00 USDC, maxDeposit 17.9M room) but EV thin and entry permissioned. Gross 0.046 USD/day per 400 USD = 11.34 pct APR (interestRateBps 1134 on borrowed 130,000.00 only), utilization 36.9 pct (totalAssets 353,585.94) -> effective 4.19 pct APR; feeBps 0. Deposit needs per-vault allowlist approval: VaultLenderRegistry 0xaf703db4f9be3246e3ebbf66f018c5f7d73fb22c approveLender callable only by its LenderManager role holder 0x44438982c55549e3c9275e2bf418ca526b69981a (approved incumbent lender block 26311781 tx 0xb405761bd60763bfd053704375bd3b2f6269c9fb75730dd5f260738d0667ce22) - needs_human: that address must approveLender the promoted bot address (gate mints fresh address per bot), one free tx. Single uncollateralized institutional borrower = whole credit risk. 7-day-window net after deposit+exit gas ~-0.4..+0.3 USD; weeks-long hold clearly positive only.

Fork-prove on ethereum 9003: reset <= current, impersonate a LenderManager, approveLender, approve USDC, deposit(400e6) expect ~398.8 shares, requestRedeem, convertToAssets delta positive. Compare against lead 112 Dexalot (0.18 USD/day ceiling) and 114 Overlayer before committing an earner to the thinnest route.
